segments.thag14.2:2.1: “Evaṃ paññāya ye tittā, samuddo vārinā yathā;
segments.thag14.2:3.3: Narā dukkhaṃ nigacchanti, tedha socanti māṇavā [mānavā (sī.)].
segments.thag14.2:5.3: Ṭhitā te indakhīlova, na te unnataonatā.
segments.thag14.2:6.1: “Na heva lābhe nālābhe, na yase na ca kittiyā;
segments.thag14.2:6.3: Na nindāyaṃ pasaṃsāya, na te dukkhe sukhamhi.
segments.thag14.2:8.1: “Dhammena ca alābho yo, yo ca lābho adhammiko;
segments.thag14.2:8.3: Alābho dhammiko seyyo, yaṃ ce lābho adhammiko.
segments.thag14.2:9.1: “Yaso ca appabuddhīnaṃ, viññūnaṃ ayaso ca yo;
segments.thag14.2:9.3: Ayasova seyyo viññūnaṃ, na yaso appabuddhinaṃ.
segments.thag14.2:10.1: “Dummedhehi pasaṃsā ca, viññūhi garahā ca yā;
segments.thag14.2:10.3: Garahāva seyyo viññūhi, yaṃ ce bālappasaṃsanā.
segments.thag14.2:11.3: Pavivekadukkhaṃ seyyo, yaṃ ce kāmamayaṃ sukhaṃ.
segments.thag14.2:12.3: Maraṇaṃ dhammikaṃ seyyo, yaṃ ce jīve adhammikaṃ.
segments.thag14.2:13.3: Caranti loke asitā, natthi tesaṃ piyāpiyaṃ.
segments.thag14.2:15.1: Revato ceva godatto, therā dve te mahiddhikā;
